_comment: bitGen Studio 2.521.0 — the trainer's LLM and VISION base models (lib/fineTune.js -> scripts/ft_unsloth.py, Unsloth). model = the Hugging Face repo (the docker's Model path replaces it); loader = Unsloth's FastLanguageModel (language) / FastModel (model) / FastVisionModel (vision); vram_gb = what a bf16 LoRA needs (Unsloth's own tables; qlora = 4-bit, full = every weight); methods = what it can be trained with; checked = the repo + settings are from Unsloth's docs (false: best knowledge - check Config). The result is a .gguf for the app's assistant (llm-models) or its vision model (llm-models/vision/<name>/ + its mmproj).

llm.label: Qwen3.5 4B - the best start (12 GB cards)
llm.note: Unsloth: 10 GB for a bf16 LoRA. 4-bit (QLoRA) is not recommended for Qwen3.5 - it trains in 16-bit.

llm.label: Qwen3.5 9B - the strongest that fits a 24 GB card
llm.note: Unsloth: 22 GB for a bf16 LoRA (an RTX 4090 / 5090 / 3090).

llm.label: Qwen3.5 2B - small and quick (8 GB cards)
llm.note: Unsloth: 5 GB for a bf16 LoRA; a full fine-tune needs about 4x that.

llm.label: Qwen3.5 0.8B - tiny (any card, full fine-tune fits)
llm.note: Unsloth: 3 GB for a LoRA, ~12 GB for a full fine-tune (every weight).

llm.label: Gemma 4 E4B - Google, strong writing (16-24 GB cards)
llm.note: Unsloth: 17 GB for a LoRA (less in 4-bit).

llm.label: Gemma 4 E2B - Google, small (8-10 GB cards)
llm.note: Unsloth: trains on 8 GB, a LoRA on 8-10 GB.

llm.label: Gemma 4 31B - 4-bit QLoRA on a 24 GB card
llm.note: Unsloth: 22 GB for a 31B QLoRA. The repo name follows Unsloth's naming - check Config.

llm.label: Qwen3.8 27B - the newest (a 64-80 GB pod)
llm.note: A 27B bf16 LoRA needs ~56 GB (Unsloth's Qwen3.5-27B figure) - Settings -> Remote GPU -> a RunPod pod. The repo name is best knowledge - check Config.

vision.label: Qwen3.5 4B vision - the best start (12-16 GB cards)
vision.note: Unsloth has a Qwen3.5 4B vision notebook; ~10 GB for the LoRA + the pictures.

vision.label: Qwen3.5 9B vision - the strongest that fits a 24 GB card
vision.note: ~22 GB for the LoRA + the pictures - an RTX 4090 / 5090.

vision.label: Qwen3.5 2B vision - small (8 GB cards)
vision.note: A quick captioner of your own.

vision.label: Gemma 4 E4B vision - Google (16-24 GB cards)
vision.note: Unsloth: Gemma 4 vision fine-tuning; 17 GB for an E4B LoRA.

vision.label: Gemma 4 E2B vision - Google, small (8-10 GB cards)
vision.note: Unsloth has a Gemma 4 E2B vision notebook.
